The [[Bone Dragon Staff]] is a [[item rarity|rare]] [[staff]] which [[drop]]s only from [[Fendi's Chest]], after completing the [[Shards of Orr]] [[dungeon]].

== Acquisition ==
;[[Eye of the North]]
* [[Depths of Tyria]]
** [[Shards of Orr]]
*** [[Fendi's Chest]]

== Dye ==
[[Image:Bone_Dragon_Staff_head.jpg|right|thumb|195px|A profile of the head of the staff.]]
[[Dye]] affects the entire staff, except for the heart. The default color can be closely replicated using brown dye.
{{dye chart}}

== Trivia ==
* This weapon is based on one of the winning designs, that of ''Rebecca Sinclair,'' from the [[Design-a-Weapon (2007)|Design-a-Weapon Contest]] held in 2007.
* With high shader quality on, blood seems to be running up the heart of the staff.
* The name of this staff is commonly abbreviated to BDS.
